experiences.description: I develop an application for a cosmetics products consultancy and build internal tools with Python and AI to speed up the team's work.
I built dynamic, efficient interfaces with Angular for applications that manage and present tax returns, in collaboration with the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT).
I collaborated on the new version of the pInvestiga software with Angular and NestJS, implementing a real-time chat, data libraries and forms.

about.tagline: I'm a very creative person with a passion for design and a strong drive to work so I can contribute to your projects and ideas.
whoParagraphs: Twenty-three years ago, I was born in Galicia. From my earliest memories, my fascination with computers shaped the course of my life.
I was always a curious person in the field of computing, which led me to study a higher vocational degree in systems, where I discovered programming and my passion for it.
Beyond computing and programming, I inherited a great love for music and the sea from my father.

However, what defines me best is kayaking. I have competed at a national level since I was 16 in this sport, which has forged my character in discipline, teamwork and has grown my social skills by interacting with people from diverse backgrounds.
Currently, my goal is to consolidate my knowledge and keep growing as a fullstack developer.

studies.title: Higher Diploma in Web Application Development
studies.description: I gained solid foundations in object-oriented programming and became familiar with Symfony and Vue. On the backend I learned to build Docker containers to deploy my projects.

studies.title: Higher Diploma in Networked Computer Systems Administration
studies.description: I learned about the management and deployment of servers with Docker and Apache, as well as working with SQL databases. This is where I discovered programming.
